scripts.ci:pr: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply yokohama-cinema-schedule --local --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply yokohama-cinema-schedule --remote --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
